name: apple-tools
description: Unified Apple tools MCP server for macOS, covering Mail, Calendar, Reminders, Messages, Contacts, Notes, Shortcuts, Files, System, and Maps.
long_description: Local MCP server for Apple Mail, Calendar, Reminders, Messages, Contacts, Notes, Shortcuts, Files, System, and Maps on macOS. Reuses the standalone Apple-native integrations while providing one coherent agent entrypoint, unified health, cross-app prompts, aggregated overview resources, assistant workflows, Finder-aware file handling, and truthful system context.

mail_safety_mode.title: Mail safety mode
mail_safety_mode.description: Type exactly one of: safe_readonly, safe_manage, or full_access. safe_readonly: read and search only. safe_manage: also drafts, replies and forwards (these send immediately), mark, move, delete, and archive. full_access: also sends new messages. This bundle's default is full_access, matching earlier bundle releases (uvx and pip installs default to safe_manage). Sets APPLE_MAIL_MCP_SAFETY_PROFILE.

calendar_safety_mode.title: Calendar safety mode
calendar_safety_mode.description: Type exactly one of: safe_readonly, safe_manage, or full_access. safe_readonly: read calendars and events only. safe_manage: also create, update, and delete events. full_access: same as safe_manage. This bundle's default is safe_manage. Sets APPLE_CALENDAR_MCP_SAFETY_MODE.

reminders_safety_mode.title: Reminders safety mode
reminders_safety_mode.description: Type exactly one of: safe_readonly, safe_manage, or full_access. safe_readonly: read lists and reminders only. safe_manage: also create, update, and complete reminders and create lists. full_access: also delete reminders and lists. This bundle's default is safe_manage. Sets APPLE_REMINDERS_MCP_SAFETY_MODE.

files_safety_mode.title: Files safety mode
files_safety_mode.description: Type exactly one of: safe_readonly, safe_manage, or full_access. safe_readonly: browse, search, and read files only. safe_manage: also create folders, move, open, reveal, and tag files. full_access: also delete files. This bundle's default is safe_manage. Sets APPLE_FILES_MCP_SAFETY_MODE.

system_safety_mode.title: System safety mode
system_safety_mode.description: Type exactly one of: safe_readonly, safe_manage, or full_access. safe_readonly: read status and settings only. safe_manage: also set the clipboard, show notifications, open apps, change appearance, Finder, Dock, and accessibility settings, and drive app menus and keys in apps listed under "Apps that accept GUI input". full_access: same as safe_manage. This bundle's default is safe_manage. Sets APPLE_SYSTEM_MCP_SAFETY_MODE.

contacts_safety_mode.title: Contacts safety mode
contacts_safety_mode.description: Type exactly one of: safe_readonly, safe_manage, or full_access. safe_readonly: read and search contacts only. safe_manage: also create and update contacts. full_access: also delete contacts. This bundle's default is safe_manage. Sets APPLE_CONTACTS_MCP_SAFETY_MODE.

notes_safety_mode.title: Notes safety mode
notes_safety_mode.description: Type exactly one of: safe_readonly, safe_manage, or full_access. safe_readonly: read and search notes only. safe_manage: also create, edit, move, and delete notes and folders. full_access: same as safe_manage. This bundle's default is full_access. Sets APPLE_NOTES_MCP_SAFETY_MODE.

messages_safety_mode.title: Messages safety mode
messages_safety_mode.description: Type exactly one of: safe_readonly, safe_manage, or full_access. safe_readonly: read conversations only. safe_manage: also send messages, replies, and attachments. full_access: same as safe_manage. This bundle's default is full_access. Sets APPLE_MESSAGES_MCP_SAFETY_MODE.

shortcuts_safety_mode.title: Shortcuts safety mode
shortcuts_safety_mode.description: Type exactly one of: safe_readonly, safe_manage, or full_access. safe_readonly: list and view shortcuts only. safe_manage: also run shortcuts. full_access: same as safe_manage. This bundle's default is full_access. Sets APPLE_SHORTCUTS_MCP_SAFETY_MODE.

files_allowed_roots.title: Folders the Files tools may access
files_allowed_roots.description: Comma-separated folder paths; ~ means your home folder. The assistant cannot see files outside these folders. Sets APPLE_FILES_MCP_ALLOWED_ROOTS.

mail_allowed_attachment_root.title: Mail attachment folder
mail_allowed_attachment_root.description: Optional. Mail drafts and sends can attach files only from this folder; pick a dedicated folder, not your home folder. Leave empty to keep attachments turned off. Sets APPLE_MAIL_MCP_ALLOWED_ATTACHMENT_ROOT.

mail_visible_drafts.title: Show Mail drafts on screen
mail_visible_drafts.description: Open new drafts in a visible Mail window so you can review them. Sets APPLE_MAIL_MCP_VISIBLE_DRAFTS.

calendar_allowed_calendars.title: Allowed calendars
calendar_allowed_calendars.description: Optional comma-separated calendar names the assistant may read or change (exact, case-sensitive). Leave empty for all calendars. Sets APPLE_CALENDAR_MCP_ALLOWED_CALENDARS.

calendar_write_allowed_calendars.title: Calendars the assistant may change
calendar_write_allowed_calendars.description: Optional comma-separated calendar names the assistant may create, update, or delete events in; it can still read the others. Leave empty for no extra write limit. Sets APPLE_CALENDAR_MCP_WRITE_ALLOWED_CALENDARS.

reminders_allowed_lists.title: Allowed reminder lists
reminders_allowed_lists.description: Optional comma-separated reminder list names the assistant may use. Leave empty for all lists. Sets APPLE_REMINDERS_MCP_ALLOWED_LISTS.

notes_allowed_accounts.title: Allowed Notes accounts
notes_allowed_accounts.description: Optional comma-separated Notes account names the assistant may use. Leave empty for all accounts. Sets APPLE_NOTES_MCP_ALLOWED_ACCOUNTS.

notes_allowed_folders.title: Allowed Notes folders
notes_allowed_folders.description: Optional comma-separated Notes folder names the assistant may use. Leave empty for all folders. Sets APPLE_NOTES_MCP_ALLOWED_FOLDERS.

system_gui_allowed_apps.title: Apps that accept GUI input
system_gui_allowed_apps.description: Optional comma-separated bundle ids of apps the assistant may type into, press keys in, or click in, for example com.apple.TextEdit,com.apple.Safari. Leave empty to turn GUI input off. Terminals, script editors and automation apps are always refused. Sets APPLE_SYSTEM_MCP_GUI_ALLOWED_APPS.
